Projects

A few things I’ve been working on for fun.

  • showup.lol

    An RSVP app my friend group has been using. We’ve been having fun drawing!

  • routes.brucespang.com

    A personal mapping tool I’ve been using for finding nice places to run. It’s very Bay Area-centric, if you’re interested in something like this for yourself please get in touch with me!

  • pawprint

    CLI for printing images and Markdown to the MXW01 thermal cat printer.

  • Strava Calendar View

    Chrome extension that adds a calendar view to Strava athlete profile pages.

  • plorts

    Thin matplotlib wrapper to make it easier to make the kinds of plots I make over and over.
